en.section.clearOnSend: Also clear the unread mark when I send a message in that session (off by default; when off, only switching away, clicking the current row again, or "Mark as read" clears it)
en.section.label: Session unread
en.section.note: A session is marked unread the moment the model produces content in it (message text, reasoning, or a tool result) — including the session you are currently viewing. Titles then run a brand-color gradient: blue while the session is running, green once it is idle. Opening or staying in a session never clears the mark; switching to another session, clicking the current session row again, or using "Mark as read" below does. The row "…" menu also offers a manual toggle. Pinning is provided by DSH itself (menu entry, pin icon, pinned-first ordering); this plugin only reads the official pinned set to tint pinned titles yellow, composed with unread as "pin yellow on the left → unread blue/green on the right". The unread set lives on the server and survives reloads.
